question: Select the Chinese greeting for “hello.”
explanation: 你好 (nǐ hǎo) is the standard friendly greeting. Literally, the characters mean “you good.”

question: Select the polite request for help.
explanation: 可以 (kěyǐ) means “can/may”; 帮我 (bāng wǒ) means “help me.” 吗 / 嗎 turns the phrase into a yes-or-no question.

question: Select the sentence expressing a positive opinion.
options: I think this is a good idea
I forgot to bring my keys
optionPinyin: tā bǐ wǒ lái de zǎo
explanation: 我觉得 / 我覺得 (wǒ juéde) means “I think,” while 不错 / 不錯 (búcuò) means “not bad” or “pretty good.”

question: Select the sentence using an “although…but” contrast.
options: If I have time, I'll go
Although I was tired, I still finished the work
Because it rained, we didn't go out
It is not only cheap, but also useful
simplifiedOptions: 虽然很累，但是我还是完成了工作。
因为下雨，所以我们没出门。
traditionalOptions: 雖然很累，但是我還是完成了工作。
因為下雨，所以我們沒出門。
optionPinyin: rúguǒ yǒu shíjiān, wǒ jiù qù
suīrán hěn lèi, dànshì wǒ háishi wánchéng le gōngzuò
yīnwèi xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ wǒmen méi chūmén
bùdàn piányi, érqiě hěn hǎo yòng
explanation: 虽然 / 雖然 (suīrán) introduces a concession (“although”); 但是 (dànshì) introduces the contrast (“but”).

question: Select the Chinese question “What is this?”
explanation: 这 / 這 (zhè) means “this,” 是 (shì) means “is,” and 什么 / 什麼 (shénme) means “what.”

question: Select the sentence about plans for next month.
options: I have already travelled for a month
I plan to travel next month
optionPinyin: wǒ yǐjīng lǚxíng le yí ge yuè
wǒ dǎsuàn xià ge yuè qù lǚxíng
wǒ měi ge yuè dōu hěn máng
wǒ bú tài xǐhuan zuò fēijī
explanation: 打算 (dǎsuàn) means “to plan to,” and 下个月 / 下個月 (xià ge yuè) means “next month.”

question: Select the sentence about commuting by bus every day.
options: I take the bus to work every day
I cook at home on weekends
I usually get up at seven
optionPinyin: wǒ zhōumò zài jiā zuò fàn
explanation: 每天 (měitiān) means “every day”; 坐公交车 / 坐公車 (zuò gōngjiāochē) means “take the bus.”

question: Select the conditional sentence about preparing in advance.
options: If we prepare in advance, we won't be so nervous
simplifiedOptions: 我们虽然很忙，但是很开心。
如果提前准备，就不会这么紧张。
我们一边吃饭，一边聊天。
traditionalOptions: 我們雖然很忙，但是很開心。
如果提前準備，就不會這麼緊張。
我們一邊吃飯，一邊聊天。
optionPinyin: wǒmen suīrán hěn máng, dànshì hěn kāixīn
wǒmen zhǔnbèi de bǐ zuótiān hǎo
rúguǒ tíqián zhǔnbèi, jiù bú huì zhème jǐnzhāng
explanation: 如果 (rúguǒ) means “if,” and 就 (jiù) introduces the result. 提前 (tíqián) means “in advance.”

question: Select the sentence expressing a preference for tea.
options: I want to buy a cup of water
optionPinyin: wǒ xiǎng mǎi yì bēi shuǐ
explanation: 比较 / 比較 (bǐjiào) softens a comparison and here means “rather/prefer”; 喜欢 / 喜歡 (xǐhuan) means “like.”

question: Select the sentence about a first visit to China.
options: I visited China twice last year
This is my first time visiting China
My friend lives in northern China
I plan to work in China for three years
simplifiedOptions: 我打算在中国工作三年。
traditionalOptions: 我打算在中國工作三年。
optionPinyin: wǒ qùnián qù guo Zhōngguó liǎng cì
zhè shì wǒ dì-yī cì lái Zhōngguó
wǒ péngyou zhù zài Zhōngguó běifāng
wǒ dǎsuàn zài Zhōngguó gōngzuò sān nián
explanation: 第一次 (dì-yī cì) means “the first time.” 来中国 / 來中國 (lái Zhōngguó) means “come to China.”

question: Thank you
explanation: 谢谢 / 謝謝 (xièxie) means “thank you.” 不客气 / 不客氣 (bú kèqi) is a common reply meaning “you're welcome.”

question: Three
explanation: 三 (sān) means “three.” The character is the same in Simplified and Traditional Chinese.

question: I'd like a cup of tea.
options: I'd like a cup of coffee.
I'd like a cup of tea.
explanation: 我要 (wǒ yào) means “I'd like” or “I want.” 一杯 (yì bēi) is a measure phrase for one cup or glass.

question: Where is the train station?
explanation: 火车站 / 火車站 (huǒchēzhàn) means “train station,” and 在哪里 / 在哪裡 (zài nǎlǐ) means “where is it?”

question: Tomorrow
explanation: 明天 (míngtiān) means “tomorrow.” 今天 (jīntiān) means “today,” and 昨天 (zuótiān) means “yesterday.”

question: I've been learning Chinese for two years.
options: I started learning Chinese two days ago.
I've been learning Chinese for two years.
I will study Chinese for two more years.
I studied Chinese before moving here.
simplifiedOptions: 我搬来这里之前学过中文。
traditionalOptions: 我搬來這裡之前學過中文。
optionPinyin: wǒ liǎng tiān qián kāishǐ xué Zhōngwén
wǒ xué Zhōngwén liǎng nián le
wǒ hái yào xué liǎng nián Zhōngwén
wǒ bān lái zhèlǐ zhīqián xué guo Zhōngwén
explanation: 我学中文两年了 / 我學中文兩年了 means “I've been learning Chinese for two years.” The 了 (le) marks the ongoing duration in this context.

question: Even though it was raining, we went out.
options: Because it rained, we stayed home.
Even though it was raining, we went out.
It stopped raining before we left.
We went out to buy an umbrella.
simplifiedOptions: 因为下雨，我们待在家里。
虽然下着雨，我们还是出去了。
traditionalOptions: 因為下雨，我們待在家裡。
雖然下著雨，我們還是出去了。
optionPinyin: yīnwèi xiàyǔ, wǒmen dāi zài jiālǐ
suīrán xiàzhe yǔ, wǒmen háishi chūqù le
wǒmen chūmén qián yǔ jiù tíng le
wǒmen chūqù mǎi le yì bǎ sǎn
explanation: 虽然 / 雖然 (suīrán) means “although/even though.” 还是 / 還是 (háishi) here means “still” and signals that the action happened despite the rain.

question: Could you tell me how much this costs?
options: Could you tell me where this was made?
Could you tell me how much this costs?
Could you tell me when the shop closes?
Could you tell me whether this is new?
simplifiedOptions: 你能告诉我这是哪里制造的吗？
你能告诉我这个多少钱吗？
你能告诉我商店几点关门吗？
你能告诉我这个是不是新的吗？
traditionalOptions: 你能告訴我這是哪裡製造的嗎？
你能告訴我這個多少錢嗎？
你能告訴我商店幾點關門嗎？
你能告訴我這個是不是新的嗎？
optionPinyin: nǐ néng gàosu wǒ zhè shì nǎlǐ zhìzào de ma
nǐ néng gàosu wǒ zhège duōshǎo qián ma
nǐ néng gàosu wǒ shāngdiàn jǐ diǎn guānmén ma
nǐ néng gàosu wǒ zhège shì bú shì xīn de ma
explanation: 这个多少钱 / 這個多少錢 (zhège duōshǎo qián) means “how much is this?” 你能告诉我 / 你能告訴我 (nǐ néng gàosu wǒ) means “could you tell me.”

question: The more I practise, the more confident I become.
options: I practise less when I feel confident.
The more I practise, the more confident I become.
I was confident before I started practising.
I practise only when I need confidence.
simplifiedOptions: 我越有信心，练习就越少。
我练习得越多，就越有信心。
开始练习以前，我就很有信心。
我只有需要信心的时候才练习。
traditionalOptions: 我越有信心，練習就越少。
我練習得越多，就越有信心。
開始練習以前，我就很有信心。
我只有需要信心的時候才練習。
optionPinyin: wǒ yuè yǒu xìnxīn, liànxí jiù yuè shǎo
wǒ liànxí de yuè duō, jiù yuè yǒu xìnxīn
kāishǐ liànxí yǐqián, wǒ jiù hěn yǒu xìnxīn
wǒ zhǐyǒu xūyào xìnxīn de shíhou cái liànxí
explanation: 越……越…… (yuè…yuè…) expresses “the more…the more…” or “the …er…the …er.”

question: If I had known earlier, I would have told you.
options: I knew earlier, so I didn't tell you.
If I had known earlier, I would have told you.
I will tell you as soon as I know.
You told me about it earlier.
simplifiedOptions: 我早就知道了，所以没告诉你。
如果我早点知道，就会告诉你了。
你早些时候告诉过我这件事。
traditionalOptions: 我早就知道了，所以沒告訴你。
如果我早點知道，就會告訴你了。
你早些時候告訴過我這件事。
optionPinyin: wǒ zǎo jiù zhīdào le, suǒyǐ méi gàosu nǐ
rúguǒ wǒ zǎodiǎn zhīdào, jiù huì gàosu nǐ le
wǒ yì zhīdào jiù huì gàosu nǐ
nǐ zǎoxiē shíhou gàosu guo wǒ zhè jiàn shì
explanation: 如果 (rúguǒ) means “if.” 早一点 / 早一點 (zǎodiǎn) means “a little earlier,” and 就会……了 / 就會……了 describes the result that would have followed.
